findings.title: Submitted evidence is not portable or byte-exact across package forms
facts: The exact bundle checkout cannot verify the packaged report because provenance.local_path is tied to the author machine absolute path.
The source archive converts 160 of 167 tracked files from LF to CRLF relative to Git blobs.
The packaged report cannot verify against the packaged source archive because source hashes, lengths, requirement IDs, and changes differ.
Manifest-addressed artifact hashes match bundle files but not the same paths extracted from Source.zip.

findings.title: Unsafe output path types and ancestry can replace directories or remove symlinks
facts: A dangling symbolic-link destination is treated as absent and can be removed during rollback.
A successful write can replace a dangling symbolic link with a regular file instead of rejecting it.
An existing directory passed as an output is moved to a hidden backup, replaced by a regular file, and the CLI exits 0.
An input's parent directory can be used as an output; the visible directory is replaced by a file while input and sibling files are moved to a hidden backup.
Preflight checks equality but not path ancestry, and write_transaction does not reject non-regular existing destinations.
